text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити and I are on our way
somewhere, but
she's been holding her
head in pain the entire
time.

Ugh, this is the worst. That medicine isn't
working
at all.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I'm fine. It's just a little headache.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It happens sometimes when I'm
modeling.
Yesterday's shoot was
especially tough, with all
the harsh
lighting.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But hey, it's not the first time this has
happened,
so you don't have to worry.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I have another shoot today... I
hope the
medicine will start working by
then.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити continues to suffer from her
headache
for some time.
